description: Guardrailed Autonomy — configures which safe draft-document actions (produced by Wave-1 agents like MRP/CPQ) a System Manager has explicitly allowed to auto-submit without human approval, under what conditions, and with what daily safety cap. Defaults to fully OFF (enabled=0) for every action type until a System Manager turns it on.

fields.label: Action Type
fields.options:
MRP Draft Material Request
CPQ Draft Quotation
fields.description: The specific Wave-1 automated draft-creation action this rule governs. One row per action type.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Must be explicitly turned on. Nothing auto-submits for this action type while this is unchecked (the default).

fields.label: Max Auto-Approvals Per Day
fields.description: Hard safety cap. Once this many documents of this action type have been auto-approved today, further matches fall back to the normal draft/human-approval flow for the rest of the day. Leave at 0 to keep auto-approval fully capped off even when Enabled is checked.

fields.label: Auto-Approve Conditions (JSON)
fields.description: Flat JSON dict of named thresholds, evaluated in Python — not a rule-engine DSL. Supported keys: max_qty (Material Request total qty), max_amount (Quotation grand total / Material Request total value), customer_credit_ok (Quotation only — reuses the app's existing Customer Credit Limit check). Example for a Quotation rule: {"max_amount": 50000, "customer_credit_ok": true}. Example for a Material Request rule: {"max_qty": 1000}. An empty/unset value means no condition ever qualifies, so nothing auto-submits even if Enabled is checked.

name: IB Autonomy Setting
